_comment: Example VAULT_ROLES_CONFIG for the EU broker. Maps each client cert's single SAN dNSName to a role + its granted capabilities (least privilege). Capabilities: ssh-ca, ssh-sign, creds, session, leases, kms, snapshot. An unmapped/trusted SAN gets 403; a cap the role lacks gets 403. Client certs MUST carry exactly one dNSName SAN (multi-SAN refused). Optional per-role `ssh_principals` allowlist restricts which SSH cert subject principals an ssh-sign role may request (omit = unconstrained).
